scope: Prospective necessary-feasibility test of an explicitly installed ideal two-stage energy relay. Not calibrated chemistry, dynamics, autonomous origin or maintenance.
law: U catalyses F->I plus2 work units; V catalyses I->Z plus4. F,I,Z have potentials6,4,0. Common diffusible I and both reactions are accessible to separate components. Joining U,V changes neither reactions nor yields. All arms use the same primitive inventory, finite startup work and virgin replacement precursor.
costs: Fabricating each component costs c>=0 work and one precursor; joining costs b>=0 and one scaffold precursor. Damage destroys one U or V and its association after the first completed F. Replacement uses a virgin precursor and costs c; rejoining costs b. Terminal upkeep costs2m>=0. Components/scaffolds have zero recoverable work credit. Startup endowment2c+b is matched and explicitly deducted from final usable work; do not debit it twice.
hypothesis: A joined relay with unchanged resource conversion opportunities cannot have greater optimal whole-life or post-damage net work than separate components when joining/rejoining costs are nonnegative.
controls: independent U,V: same two reactions, resources, load, precursor inventory and damage
role-label permutation diagnostic: isomorphic, not a disruptive shuffle control
conversion-disabled bookkeeping bound: no environmental capture; cannot pass positive net work
endpoint: Necessary feasibility only: positive whole-life and fresh post-damage net work, paid virgin component replacement, and at least one completed resource conversion before and after damage. Constructive certificates use an ideal external planner; cannot count as spontaneous behaviour.
grid_scope: All360 fixed cases are diagnostics of a symbolic nonnegative-cost dominance result, not selected physical prices or statistical seed samples. No probability, kinetic superiority or physical impossibility inference.
falsifier: An admissible joined certificate exceeds the matched independent ceiling under this exact unchanged-channel law. Stop and investigate any conservation, cost, reconstruction or independent-audit disagreement.
stop: If dominance holds, do not run a natural-world panel of this law. A successor must specify a physical interaction that changes measured rates/retention/accessible conversion and price that interaction; retain an attainable independent comparator. Do not invent favourable parameters.
